t: What Makes Consumers Want to Buy the Latest Model? | Stanford Graduate School of Business
s: It is based on how much the benefits of the new product (as compared to the old one) outweigh all the factors that typically hinder a customer’s decision to upgrade. For example, a customer is more likely to buy a new PC if it is significantly better than the one she already owns and if the upgrade seems painless and inexpensive.
